notes: Corrected: ad asher is now one fused unit on the single until, headed on the preposition, rather than the preposition taking the word with the relative unrepresented. The one English word carries the temporal limit and the subordination alike, so rule 30's condition is met and rule 22's first sentence, which governs an element the ASV has left unwritten, does not reach it; rule 30 forbids leaving a morpheme whose sense the rendering carries unrepresented. This also makes the verse consistent with the ki im fusion later in the same clause chain.
Head on the opening morpheme in both fusions, since neither pair has a morpheme carrying content the other lacks and the syntactic head is the one standing first (rule 23).
The matter takes a supplied the, no article morpheme standing on that noun (rule 15).
